title: D3: Planner as a function — the daemon invokes a fresh headless Planner only at decision points (scouts done, task held, goal closable)
spec: Why: the interactive Planner spent about 11.2M tokens on 2026-09-18, most of it re-sending a 250k context on 112 wait notifications. Build on C-O3 v3 (orchestrator/goals.py launches a headless Planner) and C-O7b (handover writes the checkpoint). Implement orchestrator/planner_runs.py: decision_points(root) scans the bus for goals (parentless triage tasks not done) and yields (goal_id, kind, payload) for: "scouts_done" when the goal has scout children, all are done or failed, no execute child exists yet and no planner run is recorded for this kind on this goal; "held" for each execute child with status held and no planner run recorded for (goal, task, hold_reason); "closable" when every execute child is merged, no queued or running children remain, and no run of kind closable exists. run(root, goal_id, kind, payload): if a Planner pid for this root is alive (goals.py identity), skip; else handover.write(f"decision {kind}"), then launch exactly like goals.start's launch step but with prompt rendered from .orchestrator/prompts/planner-decision.md ({{kind}}, {{goal_id}}, {{payload}}: "Read .orchestrator/plan.md and the bus. Decision: <kind>. Do only what this decision needs, write plan.md, and finish."), --max-budget-usd from limits.max_budget_usd.get("planner_decision", 3), record {goal_id, kind, payload_key, pid, started_at, log} in .orchestrator/runs/planner_runs.json under the bus lock. daemon.tick(): after the stages, when pool.cfg.get("planner", {}).get("autonomous", False) is true, iterate decision_points and run each (one launch per tick at most). pool.toml: [planner] autonomous = false (the interactive session stays the default until the human flips it) with a comment. Tests in tests/test_planner_runs.py with fixtures from the harness and subprocess.Popen patched: scouts_done_detected_once, held_detected_per_hold_reason, closable_detected, run_skips_when_planner_alive, tick_launches_at_most_one_and_only_when_autonomous. README.md: "Autonomous mode" paragraph.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_runs.py has the five named tests, green
With [planner] autonomous = false (committed default) tick() launches nothing and existing daemon tests are unchanged and green
planner_runs.json records one entry per (goal, kind, payload) and a second tick does not relaunch the same decision
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency
